scope.reuse: Current cached Mhc4 path performs fresh selection on visits 0,2,4 and uses cached attention on visits 1,3,5,6.

method.pisa: Sum of pisa_attention stage counter durations across all 128 chunks and all model layer visits.
method.readout_and_loss: Full GPU time minus sum of traced hidden command GPU times; score_chunk returns these two command durations added.
method.comparison: Fractions use this same profiled pass. Earlier unprofiled median was 180679.444 ms, not the denominator here.
method.limitations: One profiled run on battery; does not establish trained-model quality, reference parity, or controlled latency. No changes to runtime kernels for this measurement.
